interface.title: GPUMD Insight — Universal Trajectory Viewer
interface.field: Computational materials science / molecular dynamics (Pt clusters in Al-MFI zeolite, catalyst sintering)
interface.stage_of_work: Post-simulation inspection and exploratory analysis of MD trajectories
interface.what_it_is_for: Viewing one or two multi-frame extended-XYZ MD trajectories in an interactive periodic 3D viewer with synced playback, and tracking element-pair distances and coordination numbers (such as Pt–O and Pt–Pt) across frames.

data.note: The bundled T04 · 1200 K and T08 · 1200 K examples loaded automatically (50 frames, 292 atoms, Pt3 Al1 Si95 O192 H1, 20.09 × 19.74 × 13.14 Å orthorhombic cell). They are example data, not the tool's data model. No test files were available, so nothing was uploaded. After several sidebar changes in a row the server slowed down a lot and then stopped rendering, so the later steps could not be finished (see not_done). screens/059.webp was captured during that stall: it shows stale charts, not a result.

tree.general: Inspect and compare atomistic simulation trajectories and quantify how local structure changes over time
tree.specific: Load one or two multi-frame extended-XYZ trajectories, inspect them in a periodic 3D viewer with synced playback, and track element-pair distances and coordination across frames (shown here with the bundled T04/T08 Pt/Al-MFI 1200 K examples)

children.general: Load data and choose a workspace
children.specific: Pick a data source, Single or Compare workspace, and the datasets
Built-in examples loads T04 · 1200 K as the primary dataset and shows a summary line (frames, atoms, formula, cell)

children.general: Put two trajectories side by side

children.general: Visually inspect the 3D periodic structure over time
children.specific: Use the 3Dmol viewer(s) with the frame slider and play controls

children.general: Step through time in sync across both datasets
children.specific: Drag the frame slider, step with ▶, or use Play/Pause. Both viewers and the metric cards update to the same frame

scrolled wheel over T08 viewer to zoom
pressed Reset view(s) (zoom restored; T04 still rotated)

children.specific: Hovering shows an element and index label (O #39). Clicking pins a label with Cartesian coordinates (Pt #291 (-2.069, 0.591, 1.199 Å)); coordinates near the viewer edge can be cut off

clicked a Pt atom in T08 viewer

children.general: Zoom onto the region of interest
children.specific: Center selection zooms both viewers onto the focused Pt atoms. Widely spread atoms may not all fit in view

Representation radio: ball-and-stick (default), space-filling, or framework (thin wireframe with the focused Pt still drawn as spheres). Changing it reruns the app and resets the frame and cameras. Space-filling was seen in the run (screens/023.webp) but was not replayed by the check

selected framework

children.general: Choose which atoms are the focus, by type or by index
children.specific: Add Al to the Focus elements multiselect and type '1, 5' in Focus atoms. The local environment re-centers on Pt + Al + atoms 1 and 5

children.general: Quantify pair distances and coordination over time
children.specific: Element-pair analysis (Element A/B and A–B cutoff) drives the 'Pt–O minimum-image distance' chart; the Pt/Al-MFI Round3 preset drives the metric cards and the 'Coordination and connectivity' chart

children.general: Track the distance between two chosen element types over time
children.specific: The sidebar Element-pair analysis section (Element A, Element B, A–B cutoff; Pt and O in the default view) feeds the 'Pt–O minimum-image distance' chart. A custom pair (Pt–Si, 3.50 Å) was entered, but its result never rendered (see not_done)

children.label: scrolled main area to the 'Pt–O minimum-image distance' chart (default pair)

children.general: Read per-frame cluster and coordination metrics for one or two trajectories
children.specific: Pt/Al-MFI Round3 preset (default; Pt–Pt cutoff 3.20 Å, Pt–O cutoff 2.50 Å): metric cards (Pt cluster span, Pt–Pt bonded pairs, mean Pt–O coordination) that follow the current frame, and a 'Coordination and connectivity' chart. In Compare mode, T04 (blue) and T08 (orange) are overlaid. The red marker sits at the last rendered frame and does not follow the frame slider. Changing the cutoffs was not tried

children.label: scrolled main area to the charts (single structure)

children.general: Keep the caveat about the results in view
children.specific: A yellow warning reads 'Exploratory NEP89 Round3 MD demonstration at 1200 K. Model-internal behavior only; not a final quantitative conclusion…'. In Compare mode a caption under the charts adds that the T04/T08 curves are not a quantitative anti-sintering ranking

children.label: scrolled to the bottom of the main area

features.name: Synchronized dual 3D trajectory viewer
features.general: Show two time series of 3D structures side by side with one shared time slider and play control, while each panel keeps its own camera
features.specific: Compare structures mode: T04 and T08 3Dmol viewers under one ◀ / Play / ▶ / frame-slider bar, with a 'Frame n / 50 · t ps' readout. Reset view(s) undoes the zoom but not the rotation
steps: switch Workspace mode to Compare structures
drag the frame slider or press Play/step
read the shared 'Frame n / 50 · t ps' readout
rotate or zoom each panel on its own
press Reset view(s) to undo the zoom (rotation stays) or Center selection to zoom onto the focus
serves_tasks: Put two trajectories side by side
Step through time in sync across both datasets
Rotate, zoom and reset the 3D view

features.name: Atom hover/click inspector
features.general: Point at an item in a 3D scene to see its identity, and click to pin a label with its coordinates
features.specific: Hovering shows 'O #39'; clicking pins 'Pt #291 (x, y, z Å)' in the 3Dmol viewer. The label can be cut off at the viewer edge
steps: hover an atom to see element and index
click the atom to pin a coordinate label
keep inspecting while you rotate or zoom

features.name: Focus selection with local-environment cropping
features.general: Pick items of interest by category or ID, then crop the scene to everything within a chosen radius of them
features.specific: Focus elements multiselect plus Focus atoms (1-based indices), View scope Full cell / Local environment with a radius slider from 1.5 to 10 Å, and Center selection to zoom onto the focus
steps: choose focus elements (Pt, Al…)
optionally type atom indices
switch View scope to Local environment
adjust the radius slider
press Center selection
serves_tasks: Choose which atoms are the focus, by type or by index
Show only atoms near the selected ones
Zoom onto the region of interest

features.name: Representation and background switcher
features.general: Switch how a 3D structure is drawn and the colour of the background behind it
features.specific: Representation radio (ball-and-stick / space-filling / framework) and the in-viewer Light/Dark button. Periodic replication is fixed at 1×1×1. The sidebar Show unit cell, Hide hydrogen and Viewer background controls exist, but their re-rendered effect was never observed
steps: choose a representation
press the Light/Dark button in the viewer bar

features.name: Frame-linked cluster and coordination metrics
features.general: Compute per-frame cluster and coordination metrics with chosen cutoffs, show the current-frame values as cards and the full series as a chart, overlaying two datasets when comparing
features.specific: Pt/Al-MFI Round3 preset (Pt–Pt 3.20 Å, Pt–O 2.50 Å by default) feeding the PT CLUSTER SPAN / PT–PT BONDED PAIRS / MEAN PT–O COORDINATION cards and the 'Coordination and connectivity' Plotly chart. The red marker stays at the last rendered frame when you scrub; it does not follow the slider
steps: keep the Pt/Al-MFI Round3 analysis preset
scrub frames and watch the cards update
read the trends in the coordination chart (both datasets overlaid in Compare)
serves_tasks: Read per-frame cluster and coordination metrics for one or two trajectories
Keep the caveat about the results in view

features.name: Element-pair distance analysis (unverified for custom pairs)
features.general: Choose two element types and a distance cutoff, and chart their closest periodic distance frame by frame
features.specific: Sidebar Element-pair analysis (Element A, Element B, A–B cutoff; also reachable through the 'Generic element pair' analysis preset) builds the minimum-image distance chart. Only the default Pt–O chart was seen. A Pt–Si 3.50 Å pair was entered, but the server never rendered the result
steps: open the Element-pair analysis section in the sidebar
choose Element A and Element B
set the A–B cutoff
read the minimum-image distance chart
serves_tasks: Track the distance between two chosen element types over time
